concerns.text: Producer/consumer contract mismatch: T104 (convergence monitor) must 'flag iterations with max_iterations > 100 or tolerance < 1e-4' read from data/aggregated/convergence_log.json, but T101 (the producer of that log) defines the record schema as [iteration_id, sample_size, converged, max_iterations, error_message] — no 'tolerance' field. The consumer's second check can never fire on the log its producer writes. Either T101 must emit a tolerance field per fit, or T104 must drop/replace the tolerance check; as written the dependency is unsatisfiable.
